ticket.subject: Webhook deliveries delayed for hours
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

I'm the office manager at Fennimore Freight. Every webhook from your platform has arrived over an hour late since 16:10 UTC, across all our accounts.

Other customers in your community forum report the same delays. Nothing is lost so far, but everything downstream is late.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. When do you expect the backlog to clear?

Yours sincerely,
Freya

label_notes: clean outage (outage-webhooks-delayed): a degraded service for many customers that is not fully down is P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
